high: The generalized improve scaffold is not reusable: it copies an Xray-specific final-review prompt, leaves unrelated X-ray source/QA references and radiographer-specific evaluation criteria, points the component to a FIXME placeholder, and does not create the proposal-review prompt that its workflow tells the operator to run.

audit-all does not fail closed. It ignores prompt-generation and Codex task exit statuses, proceeds to merge after failed batches, and audit-q1.mjs only warns about missing/invalid results before writing a partial q1-audit.json. Therefore the documented promise to audit every registered Q1 can silently produce incomplete output.

The repository contains an executable pay-per-use OpenAI Images API path using OPENAI_API_KEY, directly contradicting the acceptance criterion and documentation claim that no paid APIs exist anywhere.
medium: The documented two-axis completion gate is prompt-driven rather than mechanically enforced. codex-review.mjs validates the generic verdict schema and blockers/high arrays but does not validate career_authenticity_score or game_quality_score, their presence, thresholds, or that score equals their minimum.
audit-all accepts zero, negative, NaN, or missing --wave-size values without validation; zero/NaN can prevent progress or produce nonsensical execution.

loop.mjs records configurable producer/reviewer labels but always invokes Codex regardless of the reviewer label and does not reject producer=codex. Actual reviews use Codex, but the advertised role parameterization is misleading and does not structurally prevent same-role labeling.
low: game-lab status selects recent runs by lexicographically sorted directory entries rather than explicit timestamps; current run IDs make this generally work but it is not a robust recency definition.
Temporary directories created by the Codex adapters are not removed after completion.

recommended_actions: Generate game-specific proposal-review and final-review prompts from neutral templates; resolve the registered componentPath automatically and remove every Xray-specific file, fact, and QA claim.

Make audit-all validate wave size, check every subprocess status, use fresh per-run result locations or delete/identify stale results safely, verify exact batch/game coverage, and abort without replacing canonical audit outputs on any failure.
Remove or disable the pay-per-use OpenAI image generator and its API-key documentation, or narrow and correct the no-paid-API acceptance criterion if that legacy code is intentionally outside scope.
Extend codex-review validation or add a dedicated two-axis gate requiring both axis scores, defined thresholds, and score=min(axis scores) before PASS.
Either remove the producer/reviewer CLI parameters or validate producer and reviewer identities and reject configurations that violate reviewer independence.
